mapper.select: select hd.project_category as category, (max(case when hdd.metric_code = 'electricity' then hdd.metric_value end) - min(case when hdd.metric_code = 'electricity' then hdd.metric_value end)) as kwh, avg(case when hdd.metric_code = 'power' then hdd.metric_value end) as avgPower, count(distinct hd.id) as deviceCount from hospital_device hd left join hospital_device_data hdd on hdd.device_id = hd.id and hdd.ts >= #{start} and hdd.ts <= #{end} where hd.project_category is not null and hd.project_category <> '' group by hd.project_category order by kwh desc

select d.day as day, d.category as category, sum(d.dayKwh) as kwh from ( select date(hdd.ts) as day, hd.project_category as category, (max(case when hdd.metric_code = 'electricity' then hdd.metric_value end) - min(case when hdd.metric_code = 'electricity' then hdd.metric_value end)) as dayKwh from hospital_device_data hdd join hospital_device hd on hdd.device_id = hd.id where hd.project_category is not null and hd.project_category <> '' and hdd.ts >= #{start} and hdd.ts <= #{end} group by date(hdd.ts), hd.project_category, hdd.device_id ) d group by d.day, d.category order by d.day, d.category
